accuracyChecks.method: 5 random generated items per chapter (115 items) plus one full mock (30 items) re-solved by hand against NCERT Fundamentals of Physical Geography, India: Physical Environment and Practical Work in Geography Part I; numeric items (scale conversion, local time, gradient, R sin φ, pixels, lapse rate) recomputed
fixes: salt-lake salinity figures (Lake Van, Dead Sea) removed; only qualitative statements kept
thermocline described as the layer below the warm surface layer, about 500-1,000 m thick
Kangchenjunga described as the third highest peak of the world rather than the highest peak in India
easterly jet stream described as steering tropical depressions into India, as in NCERT
non-geographical MCQ distractors (chapters 1, 3, 6, 13, 18, 22) replaced with same-topic alternatives
